scope: Bounded three-exchange hash-stratified pilot of size-tier NET flows only. 384 stocks selected from historical price eligibility on 2026-05-15 before requesting flows or looking at future outcomes. Same pretrained ranking model, rows, losses, seed, batch order, parameter count and update budget in both arms; additional flow inputs masked in control. limitations: Retrospective provider revisions and latest snapshot membership metadata; current archives may omit historical delistings. Flow inputs lag one trading session, but publication-time vintages are uncertified. Missing source tiers remain masked; no alternate-provider substitution. Development pilot on sampled stocks and recent dates, not full-universe or untouched prospective evidence. Extrema scenarios are not executed returns. Tokenizer pretraining overlap remains unresolved.
